embeddedAgent.title: Design your next program
embeddedAgent.placeholderBody: Tell me what's changing — fatigue, schedule, new goal, equipment. I'll build on what you're already doing.
embeddedAgent.quotaBody: You've hit the conversation limit for this hour. Take a short break and come back to keep iterating.
embeddedAgent.errorBody: We couldn't reach the assistant. Try again in a moment.
embeddedAgent.busyTitle: The assistant is in high demand
embeddedAgent.busyBody: Our AI is briefly overloaded — this usually clears in a few seconds. Try sending your message again.
embeddedAgent.threadErrorBody: Something failed on our side. Try again — your draft is safe.
embeddedAgent.offlineBody: Reconnect to keep building your new program. We'll pick up right where you left off.
embeddedAgent.restartConfirmBody: Your current draft will be discarded. This can't be undone.
embeddedAgent.generatingStatus: Reading your context · drafting · validating · preparing preview
embeddedAgent.draftQuotaBody: You've already used your drafts for today. Come back tomorrow to try a fresh angle.
embeddedAgent.programQuotaBody: You've hit the monthly cap on AI-generated programs. Use one of your existing programs or wait until next month.
embeddedAgent.disclosureBody: Your messages are stored on our servers and sent to Google Gemini to draft a program. Raw chat content is purged 90 days after you commit or abandon. We do not scrub your messages — avoid sharing anything sensitive that isn't about training.

embeddedAgentPreview.title: Your new program draft
embeddedAgentPreview.subtitle: Review the plan, then activate it or keep iterating in chat.
embeddedAgentPreview.missingPreview: We couldn't load your draft preview. Go back to chat and try again.
embeddedAgentPreview.argsFallbackHint: Detailed prescriptions will appear in the next refresh — UUID list shown for now.
embeddedAgentPreview.commitErrorBody: Something failed on our side. Your draft is still here — try again in a moment.
embeddedAgentPreview.stuckBody: After a couple of failed attempts the AI flow may not be the right fit right now. Pick a proven template or start with an empty program — your context is saved.
embeddedAgentPreview.noActiveThreadBody: Your draft session ended. Start a fresh conversation to build a new program.
